{{Quote|Given what we now know, let me speak plainly: Mitth'raw'nuruodo was one of our greatest heroes, a brave and principled being who devoted his life to preparing for the Vong.|Lenang O'Pali, ''Mitth'raw'nuruodo Reconsidered: A Patriot's Perspective''|<ref name="Warfare" />}}
'''''Mitth'raw'nuruodo Reconsidered: A Patriot's Perspective''''' was a publication written by the polemicist and fierce partisan for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] [[Lenang O'Pali/Legends|Lenang O'Pali]] that was released in [[55 ABY]]. The book discussed the role that the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Mitth'raw'nuruodo]], better known as [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] Thrawn, played in [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] history. A highly-revisionist and somewhat-polemical piece, O'Pali cast Thrawn as a principled being whose ultimate objective was to rebuild the Galactic Empire and establish a militarized society to resist the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Yuuzhan Vong War|invasion]]. O'Pali further cast this as being the ultimate goal of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], and claimed that the death of both and the defeat of the Empire by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] was not a victory for freedom but in fact a disaster that left [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] defenceless when the Yuuzhan Vong invaded.

==Thesis==
[[File:GAThrawn-SWI66.png|thumb|left|200px|O'Pali's subject matter, Grand Admiral Thrawn.]]
O'Pali began with a brief discussion of Thrawn's background, citing sources within the [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy]] and the [[Empire of the Hand]] to describe Thrawn's rise from a commoner to a [[Merit adoptive/Legends|merit adoptive]] of the [[Mitth family/Legends|Eighth Ruling Family]] of [[Csilla/Legends|Csilla]] for his impressive [[Chiss Expansionary Defense Force|military service]]. O'Pali stressed that Thrawn decided to give up this good luck and his connections in Chiss society after he learned about the threat posed by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]], then known only as the "Far Outsiders."<ref name="Warfare" /> The [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Ar'alani/Legends|Ar'alani]] had already [[Battle between the Chiss and Yuuzhan Vong|defeated]] a small Yuuzhan Vong [[Yuuzhan Vong reconnaissance force|reconnaissance force]]<ref name="Outbound Flight">[[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']]</ref> at [[Vun'Hanna]] and the [[Twilight Void/Legends|Twilight Void]], and O'Pali believed that this threat led Thrawn to ally with [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] after he was introduced to him via [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] by [[Kinman Doriana/Legends|Kinman Doriana]], and destroy the exploration ship ''[[Outbound Flight]]'', which Sidious told him he feared might lead the Far Outsiders back to the Republic.<ref name="Warfare" />

With this established, O'Pali moved on to the main thesis, declaring that Thrawn was "a brave and principled being who devoted his life to preparing for the Vong." O'Pali believed that he broke with his people and served the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], despite the cost to his own reputation and the [[New Order/Legends|New Order's]] institutionalised [[Speciesism|xenophobia]], because he believed that only a militarized, orderly society could defeat the Yuuzhan Vong. O'Pali suggested that Thrawn's missions in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] and his establishment of the [[Empire of the Hand]] were to create a bulwark against the Yuuzhan Vong, and suggested that he was neutralizing other threats to the galaxy proper, citing his defeat of the [[Ssi-ruuvi Imperium]] at the [[Assault on Lwhekk|First Battle of Lwhekk]].<ref name="Warfare" />
{{Quote|During Mitth'raw'nuruodo's campaign, the galaxy thought Palpatine dead. We now know he was not &mdash; he had returned to a clone body and was plotting his return on Byss. But did Mitth'raw'nuruodo know that? I firmly believe that he did &mdash; and that it was Palpatine who called him back.|O'Pali presents a judgment on the rationale for the [[Thrawn campaign]]|<ref name="Warfare" />}}
O'Pali believed that Thrawn's knowledge of the Yuuzhan Vong explained why he [[Thrawn campaign|attacked]] the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] following his return to the galaxy in [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]]: rather than serve the New Republic and alert them to the encroaching Yuuzhan Vong, Thrawn believed that the new government would succumb to the same inefficiency, corruption and separatism that had destroyed the Old Republic. O'Pali further believed that Emperor Palpatine &ndash; then thought dead after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], but in fact recuperating in a [[Cloning/Legends|clone body]] on [[Byss/Legends|Byss]] &ndash; had recalled Thrawn to the main galaxy to rebuild the Empire, which both men believed was the only type of society that could resist the Vong.<ref name="Warfare" />
{{Quote|Recent galactic history is not the struggle for freedom our children are force-fed &mdash; or should I style it Force-fed &mdash; on HoloNet channels controlled by Mothmatist news agencies. Rather, it is a succession of unlucky events that left our civilization defenseless against the Vong.|O'Pali makes a polemical conclusion|<ref name="Warfare" />}}
O'Pali went on to attack his critics, accusing them of being disingenuous to accept Thrawn's account of his discussion with Darth Sidious about the Far Outsiders but not revise their opinions of the Galactic Empire. O'Pali believed that preparation to resist the Yuuzhan Vong invasion exonerated the Empire for its numerous atrocities, and declared that the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], and the rise of the New Republic had only served to weaken the galaxy's defenses. O'Pali was contemptuous of the [[Noghri/Legends|Noghri]]: Thrawn's Noghri bodyguard [[Rukh/Legends|Rukh]] had turned against Thrawn for keeping [[Honoghr/Legends|his homeworld]] enslaved and had killed him at the [[Battle of Bilbringi (9 ABY)|Battle of Bilbringi]]. O'Pali held [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], and [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] in similar disregard for their roles in killing Palpatine and [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo (clone)|Thrawn's]] last clones, at [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] and [[Nirauan/Legends|Nirauan]] respectively. O'Pali described [[Timeline of galactic history/Legends|galactic history]] from [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]] as being "a succession of unlucky events... and as a result we stood naked before the Yuuzhan Vong and the bleak destiny they sought for us."<ref name="Warfare" />
